text: {"findings":[{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Run duration under 14 days","detail":"The test runs only 5 days, below the 14-day minimum. This misses weekly cycles, and the 6-week target cannot be assessed in 5 days.","evidence_quote":"Run for 5 days.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Run at least 14 days (ideally full weekly cycles) and align the measurement window with the success target."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Randomization by driver leaks between arms","detail":"Dispatch assigns offers across a shared pool of drivers and orders. Randomizing by driver means treated and control drivers compete for the same orders, creating interference and contaminating the comparison.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by driver.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Randomize by a unit that contains the interaction, such as geo-zone or time-slice (switchback), so arms do not share the same driver/order pool."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No MDE or power analysis","detail":"The plan states no minimum detectable effect, sample size, or power calculation. It cannot show that a 2-point lift is detectable.","evidence_quote":"Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Specify the MDE (e.g., 2 points), the power and alpha, and the required sample size and duration."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Missing dispatch guardrails for driver earnings, acceptance, and delivery time","detail":"Changing dispatch assignment affects driver earnings distribution and fairness, offer acceptance, and speed/cost. The guardrails cover only defects and safety, with no driver earnings/utilization, offer acceptance or decline rate, or delivery time or cost metrics.","evidence_quote":"Delivery Defect Rate: stop if it rises by more than 0.2 points.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as offer acceptance rate, driver earnings and utilization distribution, delivery time/ETA accuracy, and cost per delivery."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Driver pay impact and rating use without recorded review","detail":"Prioritizing by proximity and rating changes how offers, and therefore earnings, are distributed among drivers. Using driver rating as a tie-break is also a policy-sensitive use of driver data. No review (pay policy, fairness, or privacy) is recorded; only engineering capacity is mentioned.","evidence_quote":"Dispatch engineering has capacity next sprint.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Record review and sign-off from driver pay/policy and fairness/legal or privacy stakeholders before launch."}]}
